title: Refactor the AWGN link adapter
description:
Build the AWGN-side composition layer on top of the shared modem framework instead of direct BPSK helpers.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] AWGN link composition can use modem presets or custom modems through the shared framework.
- [ ] AWGN modulation and LLR generation are no longer hard-coded to the legacy BPSK helper path.
- [ ] The adapter shape is compatible with the existing simulation harness.

## Notes

This is the first integration leaf under the simulation and channel story.
